'''Arnold's mother''' (Japanese: '''ハジメの母親''' ''Hajime's mother'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP027|Hypno's Naptime]]''.

Arnold's mother mistook {{Ash}} for her son, [[Arnold]]. She revealed that Arnold, like the other children, had disappeared three days before Ash and {{ashfr}} had arrived to [[HopHopHop Town]]. Unbeknownst to her, this was due to a {{p|Hypno}}'s {{m|Hypnosis|sleep waves}}, which were being used by socialites to treat {{a|Insomnia}} and as a novelty. The sleep waves had unintentionally affected a larger area than desired, and had brainwashed several children into believing they were various Pokémon. They all had gathered in the park, imitating the Pokémon they believed themselves to be, until Ash and his friends, upon discovering their location and the cause of their strange behavior, brought {{p|Drowzee}} to the children. Drowzee promptly undid the brainwashed behavior, and the children returned to normal and reunited with their parents, including Arnold.
